derivation: For unit endpoints a,b, the minor great-circle angle is arccos(a·b). Slerp remains in their central plane and on the unit sphere. Latitude arc length is R cos(phi) delta_lambda. With the start chosen as north pole, path length R integral sqrt(theta_dot²+sin²(theta) lambda_dot²) is at least R integral |theta_dot|, hence at least R theta_destination. A meridian attains the bound.
limitations: Sphere model; no assertion of optimal actual flight time or route. Projection distorts distances. Antipodal points have multiple minimizing meridians.
